about: The reuses check-site's art-once rule (tools/check-site.mjs) found on 26 Oct 2026, each kept until its fix lands. "art" names the picture (any of its files, without size and type), "places" where it was shown. An entry passes while the picture is shown only in places it lists; a new place fails, and so does a fixed picture (one place left) until its entry is taken out. Add nothing here: give the new place its own picture.
